definitions.explanation: A non-reproductive female bee that gathers nectar, builds and cleans the hive, and cares for the young. Also used figuratively for a person who works hard without much reward or recognition.

examples.japanese: {働|はたら}き{蜂|ばち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{蜜|みつ}→蜜：14085_mitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: Worker bees gather nectar from flowers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{巣|す}→巣：02140_su⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧{働|はたら}き{蜂|ばち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦こなす→こなす：09897_konasu⟧。
examples.english: Almost all the hive's work is handled by the worker bees.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{働|はたら}き{蜂|ばち}⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{遅|おそ}く→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: Like a worker bee at the company, he works late every day.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{働|はたら}き→働き：03557_hataraki⟧ (working) + ⟦{蜂|はち}→蜂：02242_hachi⟧ (bee), with rendaku giving ばち. Figuratively it describes a diligent, self-effacing worker who does the unglamorous jobs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {働|はたら}き{蜂|ばち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{蜜|みつ}→蜜：14085_mitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧: worker bees gather nectar
- ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{働|はたら}き{蜂|ばち}: a corporate worker bee (hard-working employee)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{女王蜂|じょおうばち}→女王蜂：29897_jooubachi⟧: queen bee — the single egg-laying female at the center of the colony
